claims.claim_text_normalized: Cascade R-CNN is a multi-stage object detection architecture consisting of a sequence of detectors trained with increasing IoU thresholds.
claims.evidence_quote_short: A multi-stage object detection architecture, the Cascade R-CNN, is proposed to address these problems. It consists of a sequence of detectors trained with increasing IoU thresholds

claims.claim_text_normalized: The resampling of progressively improved hypotheses in Cascade R-CNN guarantees that all detectors have a positive set of examples of equivalent size, reducing overfitting.
claims.evidence_quote_short: The resampling of progressively improved hypotheses guarantees that all detectors have a positive set of examples of equivalent size, reducing the overfitting problem.

claims.claim_text_normalized: Cascade R-CNN surpasses all single-model object detectors on the COCO dataset.
claims.evidence_quote_short: A simple implementation of the Cascade R-CNN is shown to surpass all single-model object detectors on the challenging COCO dataset.

claims.claim_text_normalized: Cascade R-CNN achieves consistent gains independently of the baseline detector strength.
claims.evidence_quote_short: Experiments also show that the Cascade R-CNN is widely applicable across detector architectures, achieving consistent gains independently of the baseline detector strength.

claims.claim_text_normalized: Increasing the IoU threshold during training can degrade detection performance due to overfitting and inference-time mismatch.
claims.evidence_quote_short: However, detection performance tends to degrade with increasing the IoU thresholds. Two main factors are responsible for this: 1) overfitting during training, due to exponentially vanishing positive samples, and 2) inference-time mismatch

claims.claim_text_normalized: The output of a detector trained with a certain IoU threshold is a good distribution for training the next higher quality detector.
claims.evidence_quote_short: This is motivated by the observation that the output of a detector trained with a certain IoU threshold is a good distribution to train the detector of the next higher IoU threshold.

claims.claim_text_normalized: Cascade R-CNN improves detection performance by about 4 points over the FPN+ baseline on COCO.
claims.evidence_quote_short: the extension from FPN+ to Cascade R-CNN improved performance by ∼ 4 points.
